post.description: Validates e-mail and password and returns a JWT access token. Inactive or deleted users cannot sign in. Limited to 5 attempts per minute per client IP.

get.description: Returns id, name, e-mail and role of the signed-in user.
Returns a page of customers ordered by name. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

post.description: Creates a customer with CPF or CNPJ, phone and optional e-mail and address (all or nothing). Roles: Admin, Attendant.

get.description: Returns one customer by id. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

put.description: Updates name, contact and address. The document cannot change. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

delete.description: Soft deletes a customer without open service orders or registered vehicles. Role: Admin.

post.description: Finds a customer by CPF or CNPJ sent in the body (never in the URL). Roles: Admin, Attendant.

get.description: Returns the average time in minutes from execution start to completion of completed or delivered service orders, optionally filtered by completion date (from and to, inclusive). Role: Admin.

Returns a page of parts and supplies ordered by name, with stock balance. Only active items are listed unless includeInactive is true. belowMinimum=true lists only items with stock below the minimum. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Creates an active part or supply with unique code, name, type (Part or Supply), unit of measure, unit price and minimum stock. The stock starts at zero; use stock entries to add quantity. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns one part or supply by id, active or inactive, with its stock movements (entries and service order deductions) from the oldest to the newest. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Updates name, type, unit of measure, unit price and minimum stock. The code and the stock balance are not changed here. Items already added to service orders keep their copied price. Role: Admin.

post.description: Adds quantity to the stock of a part or supply and records the movement with the reason and the user. Role: Admin.
Hides the item from the default listing and blocks new service order items. Items already added to service orders are kept. Role: Admin.
Returns an inactive item to the default listing and allows new service order items again. Role: Admin.
Returns status, items and quote of a service order when the number and the customer CPF or CNPJ sent in the body match. Anonymous.
Approves the pending quote identified by the link token, deducts the parts from stock and moves the service order to InProgress in the same transaction. The token is single use. Anonymous.
Rejects the pending quote identified by the link token with the reason sent in the body and moves the service order back to InDiagnosis. The token is single use. Anonymous.

get.description: Returns a page of service orders from the newest to the oldest, optionally filtered by status and by exact license plate. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Opens a service order in Received status. The customer is identified by CPF or CNPJ and the vehicle by license plate, both sent in the body. The vehicle must belong to the customer and cannot have another open service order. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

get.description: Returns one service order with customer, vehicle, services, parts, current quote, status history and dates. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Moves a Received service order to InDiagnosis. Services and parts can only be added or removed in this status. Roles: Admin, Mechanic.
Adds an active catalog service to a service order in diagnosis, copying its current name and base price. Roles: Admin, Mechanic.

Adds an active part or supply with enough stock to a service order in diagnosis, copying its current name and unit price. The stock is deducted only when the quote is approved. Roles: Admin, Mechanic.

delete.description: Removes a service or part item from a service order in diagnosis. Roles: Admin, Mechanic.

post.description: Generates the quote from the services and parts of a service order in diagnosis and moves it to WaitingApproval. Returns the single-use approval token to share with the customer, who approves or rejects it on the public quote routes. Roles: Admin, Attendant.
Approves the pending quote in person, deducts the parts from stock and moves the service order to InProgress in the same transaction. Roles: Admin, Attendant.
Registers the customer's rejection of the pending quote with the reason and moves the service order back to InDiagnosis, so the items can be adjusted and a new quote sent. Roles: Admin, Attendant.
Moves a service order InProgress to Completed, records the completion time used by the average execution time metric and notifies the customer. Roles: Admin, Mechanic.
Moves a Completed service order to Delivered. After delivery the vehicle can have a new service order. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

get.description: Returns a page of services ordered by name. Only active services are listed unless includeInactive is true. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Creates an active catalog service with name, optional description, base price greater than zero and estimated time in minutes greater than zero. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns one service by id, active or inactive (see isActive). Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Updates name, description, base price and estimated time of an active service. Inactive services must be reactivated first. Items already added to service orders keep their copied price. Role: Admin.

post.description: Hides the service from the default listing, blocks changes and blocks new service order items. Items already added to service orders are kept. Role: Admin.
Returns an inactive service to the default listing and allows changes and new service order items again. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns a page of users ordered by name. Role: Admin.

post.description: Creates a user with any role (Admin, Attendant or Mechanic), unique e-mail and strong password. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns one user by id. Role: Admin.

put.description: Changes name and role. An Admin cannot demote themselves, and the last active Admin cannot be demoted. Role: Admin.

delete.description: Deactivates and soft deletes a user. An Admin cannot delete themselves or the last active Admin. Role: Admin.

post.description: Blocks the user from signing in. An Admin cannot deactivate themselves or the last active Admin. Role: Admin.
Allows an inactive user to sign in again. Role: Admin.
Finds a user by e-mail sent in the body (never in the URL). Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns a page of vehicles ordered by brand, optionally filtered by exact license plate. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Creates a vehicle with license plate, brand, model and year for an existing customer. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

get.description: Returns one vehicle by id, with its owner and service order history. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Updates brand, model and year. The license plate and the owning customer cannot change. Roles: Admin, Attendant.

delete.description: Soft deletes a vehicle without open service orders. Role: Admin.
